title: From Research Frontier to Laboratory Bench: Design of a Four-Tier Experimental Teaching System for Multimodal Medical Image Intelligent Diagnosis
abstract: arXiv:2609.22790v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Undergraduate programmes in intelligent medical engineering are expanding, yet laboratory curricula lag behind the multimodal, long-tailed, and distributionally shifting realities of clinical AI. This design paper presents an advanced experimental teaching system that translates an ongoing multimodal deep learning research project on endometrial carcinoma into a structured undergraduate lab sequence. We identify three educational gaps (modality, authenticity, and deployment) and derive four pedagogical principles from constructive alignment, experiential learning, the research teaching nexus, and the CDIO framework. The curriculum comprises four progressive tiers plus an engineering layer, with 32 laboratory units over 64 contact hours, delivered via a custom virtual clinical workstation using de-identified multi-institutional data. translated_title: 从研究前沿到实验台：多模态医学影像智能诊断四级实验教学体系设计
translated_abstract: 智能医学工程本科专业正在不断扩展，然而实验课程仍落后于临床人工智能所面临的多模态、长尾分布和分布偏移等现实情况。本设计论文提出了一套先进的实验教学体系，将一项正在进行的子宫内膜癌多模态深度学习研究项目转化为结构化的本科实验课程序列。我们识别出三个教育缺口（模态、真实性和部署），并基于建构性对齐、体验式学习、科研教学纽带和CDIO框架推导出四条教学原则。该课程体系由四个递进层级外加一个工程层构成，共包含32个实验单元、64个学时，通过一个使用去标识化多机构数据的定制虚拟临床工作站开展教学。每个层级都对应特定的技术瓶颈、先修课程和标准参照的考核成果（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文将子宫内膜癌多模态深度学习研究项目转化为本科实验课程，设计了一套包含四个递进层级、32个实验单元的实验教学体系，以弥合智能医学工程教学与临床人工智能多模态现实之间的教育差距。
en_tdlr: This paper translates an ongoing multimodal deep learning research project on endometrial carcinoma into a structured four-tier undergraduate experimental teaching system with 32 lab units, bridging the educational gap between intelligent medical engineering curricula and the multimodal realities of clinical AI.
